text.p: VIENNA, June 9 ( Reuter) - Top Austrian brick maker Wienerberger Baustoffindustrie said on Monday it would sell its Treibacher Schleifmittel abrasive materials unit to German industrialist family August von Finck for an undisclosed price.
In a statement, the company said it was keeping sister unit Treibacher Industrie, which makes building materials, in the group.

"The reason for the sale is the implementation of the company's strategy. It envisions an even stronger concentration on the core building materials business and stepping up expansion in new foreign markets," Wienerberger said.
The deal came just three weeks after Wienerberger sold a key Vienna office and retail complex to a local real estate fund for three billion schillings ($247.3 million) in cash and liabilities.
Treibacher Schleifmittel is one of the world's leading makers of korund, which is widely used in the abrasive and fire proof materials industries, Wienerberger said.

The unit, which employs 930 and has plants in Austria, Germany, Italy, Slovenia and North America, reported 1996 pre-tax profits of 10 million schillings on sales of 1.5 billion schillings. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 274 ($ = 12.13 Austrian Schillings)
